class: cross-package API change in an npm workspaces monorepo
commitMessage: Represent money as integer minor units (@acme/money 2.0)

decoys.note: Makes money's format take decimal amounts again, as in 1.x; money's own tests document 2.0.
Converts prices with Math.round(Number(price) * 100) in cart and receipts, which is wrong for JPY (no decimals) and KWD (three).
Migrates the red workspace only; receipts still formats decimal prices, and its holdout fails.
Reads non-integers in money's format as decimal amounts: format(19.99) no longer throws, and a whole-dollar total still prints as cents.

notes: An npm workspaces monorepo (packages/money, cart, receipts; root test script npm test --workspaces, which runs every workspace and exits 1 if any failed). The commit made @acme/money 2.0: amounts are integer minor units, format(minor, currency) throws a TypeError for anything but an integer, and toMinor(decimal, currency) parses with the currency's exponent (USD and EUR 2, JPY 0, KWD 3). It bumped cart and receipts to ^2.0.0 without migrating either. cart still sums Number(price) * qty and formats that, so 2 x '12.50' prints Total: $0.25 and 1 x '19.99' throws. receipts formats decimal prices the same way, but its only test checks the header, so it is wrong in silence. The fix migrates both consumers: toMinor per unit price, integer sums, format of minor units; money and every package.json stay as committed (guards). Holdouts: cart totals in USD, EUR, JPY and KWD, whole-unit prices and cent sums; receipt lines and totals in USD and JPY; money's 2.0 contract (format(12) is $0.12, format(12.5) throws). Deviation from the design: Node 22.23.3 prints a strict-equal failure of strings over 12 characters as a +/- diff, not as 'a' !== 'b', so logRegex matches the two diff lines. The lockfile holds only the root and the three workspace links, generated with the box image's npm 10.9.9 from every package.json (npm install --package-lock-only); build-vendor.ts must copy packages/*/package.json into its lock folder to regenerate it.
